asset.Name: Soldier Total Column
asset.Description:
[b]Soldier Total Column for Xenonauts 2[/b]: adds a Total column to the soldier management and recruitment screens, showing the sum of Health, Time Units, Accuracy, Strength, Reflexes, and Bravery.

[h2]Usage[/h2]
Enable Soldier Total Column in the game's Mods menu.

[h2]Source[/h2]
[url=https://github.com/mnshdw/X2-SoldierTotalColumn]github.com/mnshdw/X2-SoldierTotalColumn[/url]
